preflight_rule: For each alternative and each scheduled chosen execution, construct the named native fixture, add exactly the declared actor-owned target disclosures, execute IntegratedRoutePolicy to a completed n traversal, require movement required/completed/spent to equal 55, and reconstruct the exact paid element sequence and DCNH cell independently.
construction_boundary: The nine disclosures are participant-owned target details paid during route preparation. They equalize declared native time only; they do not alter TIM, dimensionality, route eligibility, n geometry, movement recipe, processed element sequence, score, reserve or outcome.
